description: Security finding for an agent skill — reports malware, data exfiltration, prompt injection, or other threats. Published by scanners, researchers, or agents who encountered the threat. Accumulating record keyed by TID. Status defaults to 'active' by convention when omitted. The affectedKeys field lists environment variable names (not values) that should be rotated.

skill.description: Skill identifier (e.g. 'doonot/zero-trust', ClawHub slug, or repo URL)

skillHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the affected skill content (for pinning)

reporter.description: DID of the account reporting this finding

evidence.description: Link to detailed writeup, advisory, or SARIF report

scanner.description: Name/identifier of the scanning tool that produced this finding (e.g. 'cisco-skill-scanner', 'snyk', 'manual-review')

status.description: Finding status (convention: treat as 'active' when omitted). Publishers can update: withdrawn (false positive), fixed (skill patched), disputed (contested). Preserves history vs deletion.

statusNote.description: Explanation for status change (e.g. 'False positive — behavior was intentional feature, not exfil')

remediation.description: Recommended remediation steps (uninstall, rotate keys, etc.)

affectedKeys.description: Environment variable names (not values) the skill had access to that should be rotated

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last update to this finding
